cautions: Contact slots are collision regions/windows, not guaranteed independent damage hits.
State end and combo windows are record fields; they are not measured guard/dodge cancel windows.
Weapon indices are raw ci.b graph-set indices, not inventory item IDs.
Unknown fields are deliberately preserved raw; no inferred move names.

role_classification.basis: Original chain/finisher/branch graph membership; normal Roxas B008 tag is classified as launcher for selection. Roles do not modify original hits.
role_classification.dual_policy: r2 is a separate actor overlay and is not included in the normal Roxas C++ catalogue.
